issues: Leftover 'ZZDRAG' party rows from prior QA session were present when starting (pre-cleaned by this iteration). Prior testing agents/main agent should sweep QA_/ZZ prefixed rows from shop-sale-rows collection.

critical_code_review_comments: useSheet.pasteSelection reads clipboard via navigator.clipboard.readText which requires clipboard-read permission - in browsers where user denies it, paste from menu button silently no-ops. Consider surfacing a toast when readText rejects so users know why Paste did nothing.

useSheet.applyMatrix always appends a trailing blank row via `while (next.length < startRow + rowSpan + 1)` for the DOWN case but the UP case does not extend the array. Currently harmless because up-fill starts at existing rows, but a future refactor should keep the trailing-blank invariant symmetric.

useSheet.fillEnd 'up' loop uses `for (let r = src.r1 - 1; r >= Math.max(0, f.to); r--)` where f.to is already clamped in fillOver via rowFromPointer which returns 0 for negatives - correct today but the Math.max is redundant defence, keep it.

useSheet.tickAutoScroll early-exits when `!selecting.current && !fillRef.current` but the raf id in autoRef.current.raf is not proactively cleared before that check; stopAutoScroll() handles it. Fine.

The mousemove global handler on window is registered once (correct). The 'past bottom' branch uses `Math.min(box.bottom, window.innerHeight) - 6` which correctly handles the grid extending past the viewport. Verified auto-scroll works in a 1920x1080 viewport.
SheetCell.jsx custom memo compare calls sheet.isInFill/isSelected inside the equality function on every parent render - it's O(N) but the two boolean look-ups are cheap. Acceptable.

OrderSheet.jsx and LineSheet.jsx both call `sheetBase.setScrollEl(win.scrollRef.current); sheetBase.setWindowRecalc(win.onScroll);` inside a useEffect with NO dependency array (runs every render). Not a correctness bug but it re-registers the callbacks on every render - consider `useEffect(..., [win.scrollRef, win.onScroll])`.

Ctrl+Z after a large fill triggers pushWhole -> replace() -> refresh(). For /orders (3693 rows) this posts the whole sheet on every undo, which will be slow on large edits. Consider server-side diff or per-row undo for /orders scale.
seed_data_creation: Transient rows created and cleaned up in shop-sale-rows and company-arrived-rows during tests. Final cleanup deleted 8+4 QA rows via DELETE /api/line-sheet/<sheet>/<id>. No changes to /orders (only read + Ctrl+A selection, no writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testids for excel features: ss-sel-count / sel-count / <prefix>sel-count (selection counter), fill-handle-<row>-<col.key> (drag corner), ss-cell-<row>-<key>. Clipboard tests MUST grant permissions upfront: `await page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'])` BEFORE any Ctrl+C, otherwise copySelection silently swallows the writeText rejection and Ctrl+V reads empty. Row height is 33px (hard-coded in useSheet.rowFromPointer AND useWindowRows). To trigger auto-scroll from playwright, hold mouse near the grid's bottom for ~2s of mousemove events - the rAF loop needs continuous events. Windowed rendering works: /orders shows ~56 DOM rows for 3693 total. Prior QA/ZZDRAG contamination in shop-sale-rows collection was cleaned by this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. TEST9 originally 'failed' during first run because clipboard permissions were granted only after Ctrl+C; navigator.clipboard.writeText silently rejects without permission, leaving clipboard empty so paste no-oped. Retest with upfront permission grant confirmed block-repeat-into-bigger-selection works exactly as spec (QA_X/QA_Y alternating 3× across 6 target cells).
